standard_prerequisites.name: The invariants of a finite group action on a ring are the kernel of the map sending an element to the tuple of its differences with its translates
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the exact sequence whose exactness under base change gives the statement.

standard_prerequisites.name: Tensoring an exact sequence with a flat module keeps it exact, so the sequence describing the invariants survives a flat base change
standard_prerequisites.use: Justifies keeping the sequence exact after tensoring, which is what identifies the invariants of the base change.

core_obligations: Write down the exact sequence relating the invariants to the ring and to the direct sum over the group, with the second map given by the differences with the translates (proof lines 32667-32669).
Tensor that sequence with the flat algebra: exactness is preserved, so the base changed invariants are the kernel of the base changed difference map (proof lines 32669-32672).
Identify that kernel with the invariants of the base changed action, which gives the first statement, and deduce the second statement in the same way (proof lines 32672-32677).
proof_roadmap: Display the exact sequence computing the invariants (proof lines 32667-32669).
Keep it exact after a flat base change (proof lines 32669-32672).
Identify the kernel and conclude both statements (proof lines 32672-32677).
